entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Metal plane with five suns, scarred landscape of iron, gold and chrome, inhabited by the Mirrans.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Former Warden of Mirrodin's machines, defeated by Glissa Sunseeker.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: Natives of Mirrodin orphaned by the soul-traps: human, elf, goblin, vedalken, loxodon and leonin.

entities.name: Soul-traps
entities.description: Devices that sent the older generations of Mirrodin back to their home planes.

entities.name: Lacunae
entities.description: Apertures in Mirrodin's surface that lead to the core, regarded as sacred sites.

entities.name: Cave of Light
entities.description: Structure built around the white lacuna, revered by the leonin and Auriok.

entities.name: Knowledge Pool
entities.description: Repository of thought-inducing serum within Lumengrid, studied by the vedalken.

entities.name: Ish Sah
entities.description: Guards the black lacuna in the Mephidross.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: Site where goblins and Vulshok celebrate the red sun.

entities.name: Araneas Altar
entities.description: Structure the Sylvok built near the former Radix at the green lacuna.

entities.name: Myr
entities.description: Odd servants that carry out curious tasks of their own.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker referred to as not being the old nemesis of next week.

events.summary: Memnarch is defeated by Glissa Sunseeker, and the green sun burns in Mirrodin's sky.
events.quote: Memnarch is gone, defeated by the elf hero Glissa Sunseeker .

events.summary: The soul-traps send the older generations of Mirrodin back to their home planes, leaving the Mirrans orphaned.
events.quote: The soul-traps were triggered, sending the older generations of Mirrodin back to their home planes.

relations.quote: Memnarch is gone, defeated by the elf hero Glissa Sunseeker .
